name: AddContainerPluginRule

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The name of the rule. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_). The names of rules that are created for the same user must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称，长度限制为1~80个字符，支持字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）和下划线（_）这些字符。说明同一个用户内规则名称唯一
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rule template. You can call the ListSystemClientRules operation to query the ID of the rule template
parameters.help_zh: 规则模板ID。通过ListSystemClientRules获取模板ID
parameters.name: rule_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The action that you want to specify for the rule. Valid values:

1: triggers alerts.
2: blocks escapes
parameters.help_zh:
规则动作模式。取值：
1：告警
2：拦截
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The check items that are enabled for the rule
parameters.help_zh: 指定启用规则的权限策略信息
parameters.name: selected_policy

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

0: custom rule
1: system rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。取值：
0：用户自定义
1：系统内置
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en: The images that are added to the whitelist
parameters.name: white_images
